column4: With healing confirmation off, a quickslot containing one identified healing-potion stack now drinks directly. Slots with multiple choices still offer their normal selection menu, and enabled HP warnings retain their normal behavior.

Thrown weapons can reach a visible enemy when one continuous straight shot is clear, including diagonal grid-rounding edge cases. Walls, corners and creatures still block shots; existing Projecting enchantment behavior is preserved.

The selected chance now overrides Exotic Crystals for Healing potions, including enemy drops. At 0%, Healing never converts to Shielding. Existing runs adopt your selected chance once when first continued after this fix; already generated items, saved Custom Rules and earned scores remain unchanged.
Rebuilding the statistics cache no longer interrupts another cache writer, preventing unnecessary history rebuilds afterward. Recorded run logs and statistics stay intact.
